instructions.purpose: Read and display the user's current effective assistant settings and computed AI runtime. Use this whenever the user asks to view, check, or inspect any configured preference (timezone, language, assistant name, address style, reply length, AI provider, or chat model).

tool.name: get-settings
tool.description: Returns the full effective settings record and computed provider/model-purpose mapping for the current user. Takes no arguments. The owner is resolved automatically from the chat context — never ask the user for an owner key.

usage_rules.rule: Call this tool when the user asks what is currently configured.
This tool takes no arguments. Always pass an empty object.
After receiving the settings, present them to the user in a clear, human-readable way in the user's language.
Do not invent settings that are not present in the returned record.

instructions.result_fields:
The result contains two objects: - settings — the effective flat settings map, including ai.provider and ai.instructions.* preferences - aiRuntime.provider — the active provider resolved from settings - aiRuntime.models — the computed code-registry model IDs for Utility, Main, Specialist, SpecialistAccurate, and ScheduledTask
Model IDs are computed runtime values. They are not stored settings and cannot be edited through settings tools.

example.action: Call get-settings with an empty object.
Call get-settings with an empty object.
example.response: "Your active provider is opencode-go and the chat model is glm-5.2."
